fusions.name: Pinged Quarry
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse of sound that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pitched Past Hearing
fusions.desc: A shriek that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignores their resistances and leaves them [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Colony Muster
fusions.desc: Musters a colony of bats that fights for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Tithe of the Hushed
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
